# Latent Aurum

> Latent Aurum is a content studio in London that makes original films, series, shorts, animation and music. Its work is made by people and assisted by AI. It was founded in 2026 by Philip Knatchbull, Giovanni Damiani and Aaron Bhugobaun. The name means hidden gold in Latin.

Company: LATENT AURUM LTD, registered in England and Wales, company number 17089705. Registered office: 167-169 Great Portland Street, London W1W 5PF. Email: info@latentaurum.com.

## Founders

- Philip Knatchbull, Chair: BAFTA award-winning CEO of Curzon for 17 years, releasing 400+ films including Oscar winners Parasite and Flow. Executive producer of 45 Years and Kneecap.
- Giovanni Damiani, CCO: formerly at Decca and Universal. Co-founder of Only Good People, whose roster has passed 40 billion streams and 35 gold and platinum records.
- Aaron Bhugobaun, CEO and CTO: ten years delivering films for Marvel, Disney, Sony and Universal. Former AI and technical production manager at Moonbug Entertainment. Has led communities of 3,700+ AI creatives for four years.

## What the studio does

- New generation: works with artists worldwide, with access to leading AI talent and communities.
- Stories: original stories for every age, including children's entertainment, anime, musicals and movies.
- Music: writes and produces music and music videos with world-class songwriters and composers.
- Latent OS: the studio's own system for making stories and music with AI.

## How it uses AI

Made by people, assisted by AI. Every project starts with people: the story, the script, the songs and the characters. AI is a tool, not the final product, and leading tastemakers direct the final cut.
